cells.scene: Two adults haul a heavy wooden crate upward with a thick rope from a boat deck, coordinated pulling effort.
A thick braided marine hawser lies in a large coil beside a ship's mooring bollard, substantial rope diameter obvious.
A round cup viewed at an angle with its upper circular rim highlighted pale blue, clear outer edge.
A mechanical winch with a cylindrical cable drum, handle and thick cable pulling a small boat toward a trailer; focus on the winding lifting device, not a truck.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — haul (v.拖曳): Two adults haul a heavy wooden crate upward with a thick rope from a boat deck, coordinated pulling effort.
TOP RIGHT — hawser (n.粗缆绳): A thick braided marine hawser lies in a large coil beside a ship's mooring bollard, substantial rope diameter obvious.
BOTTOM LEFT — rim (n.(圆形物品的)外沿，边): A round cup viewed at an angle with its upper circular rim highlighted pale blue, clear outer edge.
BOTTOM RIGHT — winch (n.绞车(带有绞盘的车)): A mechanical winch with a cylindrical cable drum, handle and thick cable pulling a small boat toward a trailer; focus on the winding lifting device, not a truck.
CROP SAFETY: each scene has 20% white margins inside its own quadrant. Top drawings fully end ABOVE 45% image height. Bottom-row heads, hair, thought bubbles and main objects begin BELOW 58% total image height. Nothing crosses midlines.
review_notes: All scenes visually checked. Stalactites hang down; annual calendar counts 1–12 correctly in a loop; capsize, dive and winch silhouettes clear; all subjects crop-contained.
